item.title: Blog Changes, Life Updates, and Upcoming Posts
item.description: I’d like to turn this blog into a useful reference for my future self, a living document of what I’m thinking about, and a commitment device that forces me to follow through on my objectives. As a result, you can expect a lot more in the coming months.

item.title: Adopting Hugo
item.description:
I am changing from raw html to the static site generator Hugo. As I plan to put more writing on my blog, writing in markdown instead of plain HTML will become more important. Stay tuned for overviews of system design concepts (as I prepare to find more permanent employment), as well as security and statistics.

Get excited.
